places.raw_name: the brown prairies toward the Platte
places.name: Hat Creek herd camp south of the Platte
places.note: Hands talk of Ogallala's whores; Deets grows gloomy about the north; a drunk cavalry captain tries to requisition the outfit's horses and is refused.
places.location_hint: brown prairie about ten miles south of the Platte, within a week of Ogallala, not far from Clara's house; Nebraska

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Deets reports it ten miles ahead, sparking whoops; the herd expects to strike it the next day.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: The hands obsess over visiting its whores; the cavalry says a horse seller lives west of it.

places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Augustus knows it is near and promises to introduce Lorena there, though she dreads it.
places.location_hint: near the Platte by Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Newt recalls a Mexican girl wading it; Deets wishes he were back on the river, where he was once shot.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus and Call tell the soldiers they're bound there; the scout sneers they'll never live to see it.

places.name: Illinois
places.note: Augustus jokingly asks the cavalry if they are in Illinois.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus boasts of twenty years fighting Comanches there; Weaver says they'll wish they had kept their cattle there.

groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp south of the Platte
groups.hint: about a day's drive south of the Platte, within a week of Ogallala

groups.label: Captain Weaver's cavalry troop
groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp south of the Platte
groups.hint: rode away from the ridge north of the herd after being refused horses; hunting Red Cloud
